housing-numbers.notes: 15-year plan period (2015-2030). London Plan minimum target of 641 dwellings per annum. Total trajectory shows 10,645 deliverable dwellings including allocations, commitments, windfall, and broad locations. Committed housing includes sites with planning permission (1400), small sites commenced (309), and prior approval granted (338). Broad locations include Bromley Town Centre, Orpington, changing retail patterns, and public land reorganisation.
